messages:
Maya (marketing): Hey — need a tight reproducible bench for the launch post + one-slide webinar. Main ask: a headline table we can cite (p50/p90/p99 + avg tokens + $/1k) and a tiny reproducibility bundle (curl + script). Appendix can have full matrix/CSV.
Priya (eng-runtime): Got it. What matrix do you want? keep it small for headline.
Maya (marketing): Headline: highlight seq_len=256 rows for two models and two variants. Appendix: full sweep. Also want cold vs warmed KV cache and a brief burst test to show tail.
Noah (runtime): Proposal: models=[redwood-rl-13b, redwood-rl-70b], variants=[fp16,int8-q4], seqs=[64,256,1024], batches=[1,16]. Headline samples: 300 per cell (good balance). Appendix: 1000 per cell. We'll do cold and warmed (10 prefix warmups).
Maya (marketing): 300 ok for headline. Please run a 200-concurrent burst (len=64) and a 10-min sustained 15 QPS run. Call out that p99 includes cold starts for bursts.
Rina (data-ops): We'll anonymize prompts and IDs. Deliverables: 1) headline CSV with p50/p90/p99 + tokens + est $/1k, 2) reproducibility folder (curl + minimal python script), 3) appendix CSV (raw per-request scrubbed rows), 4) short methodology blurb.
Noah (runtime): Smoke checklist: (a) single-sample sanity per model/variant, (b) cache warmup verification, (c) quick output-diff between fp16 and int8 for correctness. If smoke OK, run headline matrix.
Priya (eng-runtime): Timeline?
Maya (marketing): Need headline numbers + bundle by Friday noon PT for copy review. Appendix can be next Tue. Can you make it?
Priya (eng-runtime): Tight but doable if we limit concurrency and start asap. We'll queue headline run first.
bench-bot: job queued rb-2026-11-02-003 matrix=[models:2 variants:2 seqs:3 batches:2 samples:300 cache:2], est_time=3h45m
Noah (runtime): Repro curl (for appendix):
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"model":"redwood-rl-13b","variant":"int8-q4","input":"Summarize: ...","max_tokens":256,"temperature":0.2,"top_p":0.9,"seed":42}'

Maya (marketing): Perfect — include methodology blurb about deterministic seed, sample sizes, and scrub rules. Add a short note that costs are estimated using hosted pricing as of run-date. Mark with :rocket: when headline CSV is available so I can pull numbers.
Rina (data-ops): I'll prepare the scrub script and the CSV schema now.
Priya (eng-runtime): We'll post results + reproducibility bundle here when done. Tagging @Noah @Rina for visibility.
